hebrewText: וַ/יִּֽשְׁפְּכ֨וּ דָ֪ם נָקִ֡י דַּם בְּנֵ֘י/הֶ֤ם וּֽ/בְנוֹתֵי/הֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר זִ֭בְּחוּ לַ/עֲצַבֵּ֣י כְנָ֑עַן וַ/תֶּחֱנַ֥ף הָ֝/אָ֗רֶץ בַּ/דָּמִֽים

tokens.bdb: to spill forth (blood, a libation, liquid metal; or even a solid, i.e. to mound up); also (figuratively) to expend (life, soul, complaint, money, etc.); intensively, to sprawl out

As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.
